page: Amazon Web Services m7i-flex.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8488C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The system includes 128.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 5 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The CPU architecture is x86_64, featuring a 105 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations show strong performance in specific workloads, particularly single-threaded gzip compression at 32.42 GB/sec, Geekbench image processing, and static web serving throughput at 48.18 GB/sec. Geekbench single-core scores are also strong. However, multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores fall within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests yield an average of 170.39 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 89.67 GB/sec for uncached large-block writes.

While the server handles small-scale LLM text generation efficiently, text generation for large 70B models is weak at 2.67 tokens/sec. The instance relies entirely on network-attached storage, as local storage is absent, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated compute resources, this server is configured for general-purpose workloads, web serving, software compilation, and database operations.
